name: Python Development Environment
description: Installs uv and uses it to provision a standalone CPython interpreter with pip, and optionally Ruff for linting and formatting.

pythonVersion.description: Python version to install ('latest' resolves the newest stable CPython, or a request uv understands such as '3.13' or '3.12.7').

installRuff.description: Install Ruff, the Python linter and formatter.
